about: The seed keys that existed when the seed ledger (migration v44) was introduced. backfillSeedLedger marks a key offered only if it is listed here, so a category group or screenshot a later release adds is still offered to a store upgrading from v43. categoryKeys are "<referenceId> <groupId>". mediaKeys holds, for every (referenceId, mediaId) pair in media-taxonomy.json then, the first 8 hex digits of sha256(referenceId + NUL + mediaId), sorted and concatenated. Frozen: never edit.
